scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck:electron && npm run typecheck:proto
scripts.generate:assets: node scripts/generate-assets-manifest.cjs && node scripts/auto-convert-assets.mjs && node scripts/build-texture-index.mjs
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['dist', 'dist-electron', 'release'].forEach(dir => fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));"
scripts.go: node scripts/kill-node.cjs && node scripts/try-wasm.cjs && npm run electron:dev
scripts.start: npm run electron:build:ts && concurrently "cross-env BROWSER=none npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3005 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron dist-electron/main.cjs"
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:rebuild && npm run start
scripts.electron:build: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run electron:rebuild && npm run electron:build:ts && electron-builder
scripts.electron:pack: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run electron:rebuild && npm run electron:build:ts && electron-builder --dir
scripts.build:wasm: cd wasm && emcmake cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && emmake cmake --build build --config Release --parallel
scripts.dev:wasm: npm run build:wasm && npm run copy:wasm && npm run dev
scripts.proto: npm run electron:build:ts && concurrently "cross-env BROWSER=none npm run proto:serve" "wait-on http://localhost:3006 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development NARVOS_DEV_PORT=3006 NARVOS_PROTO=. electron dist-electron/main.cjs"
scripts.proto:charactere: npm run electron:build:ts && concurrently "cross-env BROWSER=none npm run proto:serve" "wait-on http://localhost:3006 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development NARVOS_DEV_PORT=3006 NARVOS_PROTO=Proto_charactere electron dist-electron/main.cjs"
scripts.proto:editeur: npm run electron:build:ts && concurrently "cross-env BROWSER=none npm run proto:serve" "wait-on http://localhost:3006 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development NARVOS_DEV_PORT=3006 NARVOS_PROTO=Proto_editeur electron dist-electron/main.cjs"
scripts.proto:combat: npm run electron:build:ts && concurrently "cross-env BROWSER=none npm run proto:serve" "wait-on http://localhost:3006 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development NARVOS_DEV_PORT=3006 NARVOS_PROTO=Proto_combat electron dist-electron/main.cjs"
scripts.body:all: npm run body:base && npm run body:morphs && npm run body:skin && npm run body:manny && npm run body:audit
